sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 5 月 27 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：MU、NVDA、CRM、SPY、ZS。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • MU stalls after hitting $1T: Pre-market high neared $985, plummeted to $903 (-3%) at the open, then fluctuated violently in the $920-$960 range. Currently at $962, barely holding the $1T market cap. The $1000 psychological barrier has been officially rejected for the first time, and the UBS $1625 dogma is facing its first real-world stress test.
  • NVDA continues to be abandoned: Dropped to $213, touched a low of $212 intraday, and has been thoroughly expelled from the spiritual Mag7 by the community. "Some of our customers are developing their own ASICs" warning + AMD stealing the spotlight; "$5T company can't even move 5 cents."
  • Trump 11am ET Camp David Cabinet Meeting (first since March 26) to pressure the Iran deal structure; Rubio says "still a few days away"; the community views it as a show. WTI ~$93, Brent ~$99; oil rebound was instantly crushed.
  • ZS plunges -21% pre-market: Revenue and EPS beat expectations but guidance missed; the community has stamped it as the "first dot-com 2.0 casualty"; pressure on CRM/MRVL/SNOW/MDB earnings AH tonight is mounting.
  • 5/29 Core PCE: Consensus +0.30% MoM, Q2 headline revised up to 4.5%, but almost no one in the community cares.

社区氛围：混乱且看涨，但首次显示出真正的疲劳迹象。开盘时的即时抛售在牛市中引发了“WTF”和“他妈的吓坏了”的恐慌情绪，但对 V 型复苏的信念仍然占主导地位（“V 型将是圣经”，“每次下跌都会被买入”）。贪婪指数：~78（小幅回调，但仍然很高）。大多数人将今天 -0.07% 的 SPY 视为一场“灾难”——这本身就是一个顶级信号。一些清醒的声音正在出现：诸如“爆炸顶”、“万亿美元公司像模因股票一样移动”和“泡沫”等术语正在从讽刺转变为偶尔的严肃讨论。 WSB 情绪与实际走势有所偏差：SPY 几乎持平，QQQ 略有下降，但社区的表现就像是 -3% 的一天，反映出极度集中和杠杆过高。
